properties.description: Occupancy matches an independent depth-16 queue with pre-edge acceptance, simultaneous transfers, boundary rejection, and synchronous reset.
Full is asserted exactly when the independent queue contains 16 words.
Empty is asserted exactly when the independent queue contains no words.
Whenever the independent queue is nonempty, asynchronous output data equals its oldest accepted word, including across pointer wrap and simultaneous transfers. Empty data is not checked.
After a synchronous reset edge, occupancy is zero, full is clear, and empty is asserted, including reset during operation.
Public occupancy stays within 0 through 16 and public full/empty flags agree with its boundary values; unknown status values are rejected.
